title: Protein Design by Integrating Machine Learning with Quantum Annealing and Quantum-inspired Optimization
relevance: Directly proposes integrating ML with quantum-inspired algorithms for protein design. Shows quantum-inspired reformulation outperforms conventional optimization even classically. Core reference for this concept.
key_finding: Quantum-inspired reformulation of protein design outperforms conventional sequence optimization on classical machines, suggesting a new paradigm approach.

title: ESMStabP: A Regression Model for Protein Thermostability Prediction
relevance: ESM-based regression model for protein thermostability prediction. Could provide the h terms (single-mutation energies) for the QUBO Hamiltonian.
key_finding: ESM-based regression achieves strong correlation with experimental thermostability measurements.

title: Accurate predictions of protein mutational effects accelerated with a hybrid-topology free energy protocol
relevance: Hybrid-topology free energy perturbation for mutation effects. Provides physics-based reference values that could validate or calibrate QUBO energy terms.
key_finding: Hybrid-topology free energy protocol accelerates accurate mutation effect predictions.
